title: MV Use AI model in RPG Maker

posts.author: moyu77
posts.body:
Hello,
I created a GitHub project 100gptgames. The goal is to explore how AI can power the traditional games. My first simple demo is "catch the bat". It uses AI model to control the flow.  The purpose of the demo is to find out how to integrate the LLM mode into the game. Welcome everyone to join or help to improve the demos.
Challenges
Latency in API calls
when using AI models that can impact real-time responsiveness in gameplay.
Context awareness
: One major challenge is helping the AI understand in-game factors.
For example, I want to create an AI-driven NPC to complete a specific task. However, since the NPC lacks any visual perception, it's challenges to pass all game states—like other NPC's behaviors or the structure of the map to the NPC.
